flags.description: What the product does, decided without a release. This is the configuration: what a person actually experiences is the result of resolving it (user exception, organization exception, rollout, global switch).
flags.enabledHint: While this is on, the rollout is not even looked at.
flags.formHint: The global switch applies to everyone; the rollout is only consulted while it is off; exceptions beat both.
flags.keyHint: Lowercase and dots, for example notifications.inApp. The key cannot be changed later: a name that disappears turns the feature off silently.
flags.noOverrides: No exceptions: everyone gets the same answer.
flags.overridesHint: A different answer for one organization or one person. These beat both the rollout and the global switch.
flags.rolloutHint: Share of organizations that see it while the global switch is off. The same organization always stays on the same side.
flags.title: Feature flags
